detached_structure.evidence: A small structure with a flat tan roof and an attached deck sits just west of the main house, and a red canopy or tarp sits southwest of it. It may be an attached addition rather than a separate building.
detached_structure.detail: Small outbuilding or addition with a deck; red tarp or canopy nearby

signals.notes: The house has a brown roof with some uneven weathering and sits on a large lawn with mature trees. A small addition or shed with a deck and a red tarp is on the west side. The driveway is empty, and a paved road runs along the east side of the lot.
